VZ.rationale: VZ presents a compelling valuation case: PE at 11.1x (floor of 1-year range, down from 17.9x a year ago) with a 9% earnings yield offering ~450bps spread over the 10-year Treasury, while underlying profitability has improved materially (net margin 7.6% → 12.8%, ROE 10.5% → 17%). The margin sustainability concern flagged by the quant report is actually strengthened by the qual report's finding that Q1 2026 included $1.1B in severance charges — margins expanded *despite* this one-time drag, making the improvement more credible. Q1 2026 operational momentum is genuine: first positive Q1 postpaid phone net adds since 2013 (+55K), record adjusted EBITDA of $13.4B, GAAP EPS beat ($1.28 vs $1.21 consensus), and raised full-year EPS guidance to $4.95–$4.99. FCF of $3.8B in Q1 (up 4% YoY) with $21.5B+ full-year guidance supports the ~6% dividend yield and deleveraging path toward 2.0x net debt/EBITDA by 2027. The narrow-moat franchise is structurally sound with FWA actively eroding cable broadband subs. However, the 3x debt-to-equity ratio, elevated Baa spreads (6.09%), and structurally flat organic revenue growth cap the score. The nearstar is a mature cash-flow harvesting story, not a growth re-rating — the valuation discount is real but partially justified by leverage risk and limited top-line optionality. Score reflects a solidly attractive fundamental/valuation profile with a modest near-term catalyst from the Q1 beat-and-raise, tempered by balance-sheet caution.
key_factors: PE diluted at 11.1x (floor of 365-day range 11.1–21.2x), down from 17.9x a year ago — rare configuration of improving earnings at compressing multiple
Earnings yield of 9.0% vs 10-year Treasury at 4.47%, implying ~450bps equity risk premium for a stable telecom
Net margin improved from 7.6% (2025-05-15) to 12.8% (2026-05-14); ROE from 10.5% to 17.0% — margin expansion occurred despite $1.1B Q1 severance charge, strengthening sustainability case
Q1 2026 GAAP EPS $1.28 beat consensus $1.21; adjusted EPS up 7.6% YoY; record adjusted EBITDA of $13.4B; full-year EPS guidance raised to $4.95–$4.99
First positive Q1 postpaid phone net adds since 2013 (+55K); postpaid phone net add guidance raised to top half of 750K–1M range
Q1 2026 FCF of $3.8B (up 4% YoY); full-year FCF guidance of $21.5B+; operating cash flow of $7.98B in Q1
~6% dividend yield with 20 consecutive years of increases; $5.4B returned to shareholders in Q1 including $2.5B buybacks
Debt-to-equity ~3.0x ($313.26B liabilities / $104.62B equity); Baa yield at 6.09% creates refinancing headwind; management targeting 2.0x net debt/EBITDA by 2027
FWA reaching 4.8M+ subscribers, actively eroding cable broadband base (Comcast/Charter lost 1M+ subs since 2023)
Frontier acquisition ($20B) expanding fiber passings to 25–32M homes; Q1 integration on track with revenue partly reflecting contribution
Morningstar fair value estimate $53/share (vs $47.06 close), narrow economic moat rating
Revenue structurally flat ex-acquisition (~2.9% YoY including Frontier); no organic top-line growth lever
